message: "shop.audit" is not a table this agent can read: it does not exist, or the agent has no access to it

nextSteps.text: Search for the table by name: it may be spelled differently or sit in another schema.
Tell the person the table was not found or is not granted to you, and ask whether you should have it.
Tell the agent to add the table once you decide it should have it, or which table to use instead.
When the person tells you to add it, run this and show them the link it prints, where they grant the table.

personMessage: The agent asked for a table it cannot see: it does not exist, or the agent may not read it. An agent uses one database; a table in another database needs its own agent. To give the agent a table, tell it: it gives you a link where you pick the tables.
